summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Itau Unibanco Holding S.A., a Brazilian bank, furnishing its annual Reference Form (Formulário de Referência) for 2024 under CVM Resolution No. 80. The document contains standard disclosure items such as issuer activities, executive officers, projections, and risk factors, with a history of version updates. There is no transaction, corporate action, or special situation event described. The filing is a periodic regulatory update, not a merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or any other special situation. Accordingly, it does not qualify as a special-situations category.
